title: The Crypto Strategy I'm Using to Make Millions by 2028
description: Around $700 billion was wiped out of crypto in around three weeks, and there is one loop I am running through this dump that I plan to turn into millions by 2028.

I break down the five things that stacked up behind the dump, my real entries on $PIEVERSE (called at around a $65 million market cap before it touched $1 billion) and $EVAA (around a 13X in under four weeks), and the software I built to find new coins early.
